accept.zh-CN: 接受上传的文件类型，写法同 input 的 accept：文件后缀（如 `.jpg`）或 MIME type，用逗号分隔。
accept.en-US: Accepted file types, written like the accept attribute of input: file extensions such as `.jpg` or MIME types, separated by commas.

addOnPasting.zh-CN: 粘贴（paste 事件）时是否把剪贴板中的文件加入文件列表，无需额外授权。
addOnPasting.en-US: Whether files in the clipboard are added to the file list on paste, without extra permission.

afterUpload.zh-CN: 上传完成且没有出错后的钩子，返回的对象用于更新文件状态、校验信息、名称和预览地址；不支持异步返回。
afterUpload.en-US: Hook after an upload completes without error. The returned object updates the file status, validate message, name and preview URL. Async results are not supported.

beforeClear.zh-CN: 清空文件前的回调，返回 `false`、resolve 为 `false` 的 Promise 或 reject 的 Promise 会阻止清空。
beforeClear.en-US: Called before the list is cleared. Returning `false`, or a Promise that resolves to `false` or rejects, blocks the clear.

beforeCrop.zh-CN: 图片裁切前的回调，只用第一张选中的图片调用一次，结果决定整批是否裁切。返回 `false` 跳过裁切直接上传，支持异步返回。
beforeCrop.en-US: Called once with the first selected image before the crop modal opens; the result decides cropping for the whole batch. Return `false` to upload without cropping. May return a Promise.

beforeRemove.zh-CN: 移除文件前的回调，返回 `false`、resolve 为 `false` 的 Promise 或 reject 的 Promise 会阻止移除。
beforeRemove.en-US: Called before a file is removed. Returning `false`, or a Promise that resolves to `false` or rejects, blocks the removal.

beforeUpload.zh-CN: 上传文件前的钩子，返回的对象用于更新文件状态并控制是否上传；返回 boolean 表示通过或失败，返回 Promise 时 resolve 为通过、reject 为失败。
beforeUpload.en-US: Hook before a file is uploaded. The returned object updates the file status and decides whether to upload. A boolean means pass or fail; for a Promise, resolve passes and reject fails.

capture.zh-CN: 媒体拍摄的方式，可选 `user`、`environment`；传 `true` 输出空值属性，传 `false` 不输出该属性。
capture.en-US: How media is captured: `user` or `environment`. `true` renders the attribute with an empty value, `false` omits it.

children.zh-CN: 触发区内容。拖拽模式下替换整个默认拖拽区内容。
children.en-US: Trigger content. In draggable mode it replaces the whole default drag area content.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

crop.zh-CN: 启用图片裁切。传 `true` 使用默认配置，传对象自定义裁切参数；点击选择、拖拽、粘贴、替换都会裁切。
crop.en-US: Enables image cropping. `true` uses the defaults, an object configures the cropper. Selecting, dragging, pasting and replacing all crop.

cropModalProps.zh-CN: 裁切弹窗 Modal 的属性；visible、title、okText、cancelText、onOk、onCancel 由组件内置，width 缺省为 600。
cropModalProps.en-US: Props of the crop Modal. visible, title, okText, cancelText, onOk and onCancel belong to Upload; width defaults to 600.

customRequest.zh-CN: 替换内置 XMLHttpRequest 的自定义请求方法，需自行调用入参的 onProgress、onError、onSuccess 更新状态。
customRequest.en-US: Replaces the built-in XMLHttpRequest. It must call the onProgress, onError and onSuccess it receives to update the state.

data.zh-CN: 上传时附带的额外参数，或根据文件返回额外参数的函数。
data.en-US: Extra parameters sent with the upload, or a function that returns them for a file.

defaultFileList.zh-CN: 初始的已上传文件列表，非受控。每项的 `uid` 必填且不能重复。
defaultFileList.en-US: Initial list of uploaded files, uncontrolled. The `uid` of every item is required and must be unique.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用。禁用后不再显示移除、重试、替换和清空操作。
disabled.en-US: Whether Upload is disabled. A disabled Upload no longer shows the remove, retry, replace and clear actions.

dragIcon.zh-CN: 拖拽区左侧的图标，不传时显示默认图标。
dragIcon.en-US: Icon on the left of the drag area. The default icon is shown when omitted.

dragMainText.zh-CN: 拖拽区的主文本，不传时显示语言包中的文案。
dragMainText.en-US: Main text of the drag area. The locale text is shown when omitted.

dragSubText.en-US: Help text of the drag area.

draggable.en-US: Whether dragging files to upload is supported.

fileList.zh-CN: 受控的文件列表。传入后 Upload 即为受控组件，需在 onChange 中回写新数组。每项的 `uid` 必填且不能重复。
fileList.en-US: Controlled file list. Passing it makes Upload a controlled component; write a new array back in onChange. The `uid` of every item is required and must be unique.

fileListTitle.zh-CN: 文件列表的标题区域。传入 ReactNode 时只替换标题文字，清空按钮保持默认；传入函数时可完全自定义标题区（含清空按钮），参数为 `fileList`、`onClear`、`clearText`。
fileListTitle.en-US: Title area of the file list. A ReactNode replaces only the title text and keeps the default clear button. A function replaces the whole title area including the clear button, with `fileList`, `onClear` and `clearText`.

fileName.zh-CN: 作用与 name 相同，主要在 Form.Upload 中使用，避免与 Field 的 name 冲突。
fileName.en-US: Same as name. Mainly used in Form.Upload to avoid clashing with the name of Field.

headers.zh-CN: 上传时附带的 headers，或根据文件返回 headers 的函数。
headers.en-US: Headers sent with the upload, or a function that returns them for a file.

hotSpotLocation.zh-CN: 照片墙添加按钮的位置，可选 `start` 或 `end`。
hotSpotLocation.en-US: Position of the picture wall add button: `start` or `end`.

itemStyle.en-US: Inline style of the file cards.

limit.zh-CN: 最多允许上传的文件个数。为 1 时始终用最新选择的文件替换当前文件，不触发 onExceed。
limit.en-US: Maximum number of files. With 1, the newest file always replaces the current one and onExceed is not called.

listType.zh-CN: 文件列表的展示类型，可选 `list`、`picture`、`none`；`none` 不渲染文件列表，只保留触发区。
listType.en-US: How the file list is displayed: `list`, `picture` or `none`. `none` renders no file list, only the trigger area.

maxSize.zh-CN: 文件体积上限，单位 KB。

minSize.zh-CN: 文件体积下限，单位 KB。

multiple.zh-CN: 是否允许一次选择多个文件。
multiple.en-US: Whether several files can be selected at once.

name.zh-CN: 上传时使用的文件字段名。
name.en-US: Field name used for the file when uploading.

onAcceptInvalid.zh-CN: 接收到的文件不符合 accept 时的回调，参数为不符合的文件（一般是选择文件夹或拖入了格式不符的文件）。
onAcceptInvalid.en-US: Called when received files do not match accept, with those files. This usually happens when a folder with mixed file types is selected or a file of another type is dropped.

onChange.zh-CN: 文件状态变化时调用，包括上传中、成功、失败。参数为 `{ fileList, currentFile }`，通过 `insert` 插入文件时 `currentFile` 为 `null`。
onChange.en-US: Called when a file status changes, including uploading, success and failure. The argument is `{ fileList, currentFile }`; currentFile is null for files added with insert.

onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is clicked.

onCropError.zh-CN: 图片裁切失败时的回调，参数为错误对象。
onCropError.en-US: Called when cropping an image fails, with the error.

onDrop.zh-CN: 拖拽的元素在拖拽区上释放时调用，参数为原生 drop 事件、拖入的文件和当前文件列表。
onDrop.en-US: Called when a dragged element is released on the drag area, with the native drop event, the dropped files and the current file list.

onError.zh-CN: 上传出错时的回调，参数为错误、文件、当前文件列表和 xhr。使用 customRequest 时，xhr 是使用方传给 customRequest 的 onError 的对象。
onError.en-US: Called when an upload fails, with the error, the file, the current file list and the xhr. With customRequest, xhr is the object passed to its onError.

onExceed.zh-CN: 文件总数超出 `limit` 时的回调，参数为截断前本次选中的原始文件。
onExceed.en-US: Called when the total number of files exceeds `limit`, with the originally selected files before truncation.

onFileChange.zh-CN: 选中文件后的回调，参数为选中的文件。
onFileChange.en-US: Called after files are selected, with the selected files.

onOpenFileDialog.zh-CN: 打开系统文件选择窗口时的回调。
onOpenFileDialog.en-US: Called when the system file dialog opens.

onPastingError.zh-CN: `addOnPasting` 为 `true` 时，读取剪贴板中的文件失败（`getAsFile()` 返回 `null` 或抛错）的回调。
onPastingError.en-US: Called when addOnPasting is `true` and a clipboard file cannot be read (`getAsFile()` returns `null` or throws).

onPreviewClick.zh-CN: 点击文件卡片时的回调，参数为该文件。传入后文件卡片可点击并显示预览按钮，是否传入会改变渲染。
onPreviewClick.en-US: Called when a file card is clicked, with the file. While present the file cards are clickable and show a preview button; its presence changes the rendering.

onProgress.zh-CN: 上传过程中的回调，参数为百分比、文件和当前文件列表。
onProgress.en-US: Called while uploading, with the percentage, the file and the current file list.

onRemove.zh-CN: 移除文件后的回调，参数为被移除的 File 对象、当前文件列表和被移除的文件项。来自 `defaultFileList` 且没有 File 对象的项，第一个参数为 `undefined`。
onRemove.en-US: Called after a file is removed, with its File object, the current file list and the removed item. For an item without a File object, such as one from defaultFileList, the first argument is `undefined`.

onRetry.zh-CN: 点击重试时的回调，参数为文件。
onRetry.en-US: Called when retry is clicked, with the file.

onSizeError.zh-CN: 文件体积不符合 `maxSize` 或 `minSize` 时的回调，参数为文件和当前文件列表。
onSizeError.en-US: Called when a file size violates `maxSize` or `minSize`, with the file and the current file list.

onSuccess.zh-CN: 上传成功后的回调，参数为服务端响应、文件和当前文件列表。
onSuccess.en-US: Called after a successful upload, with the server response, the file and the current file list.

picHeight.zh-CN: 照片墙模式下图片的展示高度。
picHeight.en-US: Display height of the pictures in picture mode.

picWidth.zh-CN: 照片墙模式下图片的展示宽度。
picWidth.en-US: Display width of the pictures in picture mode.

previewFile.zh-CN: 自定义预览逻辑，返回的内容替换原缩略图，只在 `list` 模式下有效。
previewFile.en-US: Custom preview that replaces the thumbnail. Only applies in list mode.

prompt.zh-CN: 提示文本，`ReactNode`。与直接写在 `children` 中不同，点击它不会触发上传。
prompt.en-US: Prompt text as a ReactNode. Unlike content in children, clicking it does not trigger an upload.

promptPosition.zh-CN: 提示文本的位置，可选 `left`、`right`、`bottom`。`list` 模式相对触发区，`picture` 模式相对图片列表。
promptPosition.en-US: Position of the prompt: `left`, `right` or `bottom`. In list mode it is relative to the trigger, in picture mode to the picture list.

ref.zh-CN: 命令式句柄，挂载 `insert`、`upload`、`openFileDialog` 方法。
ref.en-US: Imperative handle that carries the `insert`, `upload` and `openFileDialog` methods.

renderFileItem.zh-CN: 自定义文件卡片的渲染，参数为 `RenderFileItemProps`，并额外包含 `key`。
renderFileItem.en-US: Custom render of a file card, with `RenderFileItemProps` and a `key`.

renderFileOperation.zh-CN: 自定义列表项的操作区，只在 `list` 模式下有效。
renderFileOperation.en-US: Custom operation area of a list item. Only applies in list mode.

renderPicClose.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙的关闭按钮，参数为 `className` 和 `remove`，只在照片墙模式下有效。
renderPicClose.en-US: Custom close button of the picture wall, with `className` and `remove`. Only applies in picture mode.

renderPicInfo.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙信息，只在照片墙模式且 `showPicInfo` 为 `true` 时有效。
renderPicInfo.en-US: Custom picture wall information. Only applies in picture mode with showPicInfo set to `true`.

renderPicPreviewIcon.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙悬停时的预览图标，只在照片墙模式下有效。
renderPicPreviewIcon.en-US: Custom preview icon shown on hover in the picture wall. Only applies in picture mode.

renderThumbnail.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙缩略图，只在照片墙模式下有效。
renderThumbnail.en-US: Custom picture wall thumbnail. Only applies in picture mode.

showClear.zh-CN: `list` 模式下，`limit` 不为 1 且至少有一个文件时，是否展示清空按钮。
showClear.en-US: In list mode, whether to show the clear button when limit is not 1 and there is at least one file.

showPicInfo.zh-CN: 是否显示图片信息，只在照片墙模式下有效。
showPicInfo.en-US: Whether to show picture information. Only applies in picture mode.

showReplace.zh-CN: 上传成功后，文件卡片内是否展示替换按钮。
showReplace.en-US: Whether the file card shows a replace button after a successful upload.

showRetry.zh-CN: 上传失败时，文件卡片内是否展示重试按钮。
showRetry.en-US: Whether the file card shows a retry button when the upload fails.

showTooltip.zh-CN: 文件名过长时是否展示提示。传对象时可配置 `type`（`tooltip` 或 `popover`）、透传给浮层的 `opts`，以及自定义弹出层的 `renderTooltip`。
showTooltip.en-US: Whether a truncated file name shows a tooltip. An object sets `type` (`tooltip` or `popover`), `opts` passed to the popup, and `renderTooltip` for a custom popup.

showUploadList.en-US: Whether to show the file list.

timeout.zh-CN: 不生效：组件不读取该属性。
timeout.en-US: Has no effect; the component does not read it.

transformFile.zh-CN: 选中文件后、上传前的转换函数，返回要上传的 File。
transformFile.en-US: Called after a file is selected and before it is uploaded; returns the File to upload.

uploadTrigger.zh-CN: 触发上传的时机，`auto` 选中后自动上传，`custom` 需调用 `ref` 上的 `upload` 方法。
uploadTrigger.en-US: When uploading starts: `auto` uploads on selection, `custom` waits for the upload method on the ref.

validateMessage.en-US: Validate message of the whole Upload, as a ReactNode.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，影响根元素的样式，可选 `default`、`error`、`warning`、`success`。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status, which styles the root element: `default`, `error`, `warning` or `success`.

withCredentials.zh-CN: 上传请求是否携带 Cookie。
withCredentials.en-US: Whether the upload request carries cookies.

insert.zh-CN: 上传文件，传入 `index` 时插入到指定位置，不传则插入到最后。
insert.en-US: Adds files at `index`, or at the end when `index` is omitted.

upload.zh-CN: 手动开始上传，配合 `uploadTrigger` 为 `custom` 使用。
upload.en-US: Starts the upload manually. Use it with uploadTrigger set to `custom`.

index.en-US: Position of the file in the list.

listType.en-US: Display type of the card: `list`, `picture` or `none`.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用，禁用后不显示移除、重试和替换按钮。
disabled.en-US: Whether the card is disabled. A disabled card shows no remove, retry or replace button.

showRetry.zh-CN: 上传失败时是否展示重试按钮，文件自身的 `showRetry` 优先。
showRetry.en-US: Whether to show a retry button on failure. The showRetry of the file wins.

showReplace.zh-CN: 上传成功后是否展示替换按钮，文件自身的 `showReplace` 优先。
showReplace.en-US: Whether to show a replace button after success. The showReplace of the file wins.

showPicInfo.zh-CN: 是否显示图片信息，只在照片墙模式下有效。
showPicInfo.en-US: Whether to show picture information. Only applies in picture mode.

showTooltip.zh-CN: 文件名过长时是否展示提示，或配置提示的类型和透传属性。
showTooltip.en-US: Whether a truncated file name shows a tooltip, or the tooltip type and the props passed to it.

picWidth.zh-CN: 照片墙模式下图片的宽度。
picWidth.en-US: Width of the picture in picture mode.

picHeight.zh-CN: 照片墙模式下图片的高度。
picHeight.en-US: Height of the picture in picture mode.

validateMessage.zh-CN: 校验信息，ReactNode，优先于文件自身的 `validateMessage`。
validateMessage.en-US: Validate message as a ReactNode. Wins over the validateMessage of the file.

className.zh-CN: 文件卡片的类名，不会应用到根元素。
className.en-US: Class name of the card. It is not applied to the root element.

previewFile.zh-CN: 自定义预览逻辑，返回的内容替换原缩略图，只在 `list` 模式下有效。
previewFile.en-US: Custom preview that replaces the thumbnail. Only applies in list mode.

renderThumbnail.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙缩略图，只在照片墙模式下有效。
renderThumbnail.en-US: Custom picture wall thumbnail. Only applies in picture mode.

renderPicInfo.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙信息，只在照片墙模式下有效。
renderPicInfo.en-US: Custom picture wall information. Only applies in picture mode.

renderPicPreviewIcon.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙悬停时的预览图标，只在照片墙模式下有效。
renderPicPreviewIcon.en-US: Custom preview icon shown on hover in the picture wall. Only applies in picture mode.

renderPicClose.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙的关闭按钮，参数为 `className` 和 `remove`，只在照片墙模式下有效。
renderPicClose.en-US: Custom close button of the picture wall, with `className` and `remove`. Only applies in picture mode.

renderFileOperation.zh-CN: 自定义列表项的操作区，只在 `list` 模式下有效。
renderFileOperation.en-US: Custom operation area of a list item. Only applies in list mode.

onPreviewClick.zh-CN: 点击卡片时的回调。传入后卡片可点击并显示预览按钮，是否传入会改变渲染。
onPreviewClick.en-US: Called when the card is clicked. While present the card is clickable and shows a preview button; its presence changes the rendering.

uid.zh-CN: 文件唯一标识符，列表内必须唯一。
uid.en-US: Unique identifier of the file. Must be unique in the list.

url.zh-CN: 文件地址，图片墙用它展示图片，预览时使用。
url.en-US: File URL. The picture wall shows the image from it, and previews use it.

preview.zh-CN: 是否根据 `url` 进行预览。
preview.en-US: Whether to preview from the url.

response.zh-CN: xhr 的响应。请求成功时为响应体，失败时为对应的错误。
response.en-US: Response of the xhr. The response body on success, or the matching error on failure.

fileInstance.zh-CN: 浏览器实际获取到的文件对象，继承自 Blob。
fileInstance.en-US: The File object the browser provides, which extends Blob.

shouldUpload.en-US: Whether the file should still be uploaded.

_sizeInvalid.zh-CN: 内部标记，文件大小超出限制时由组件设置，Upload 据此显示大小不合法的提示，无需手动传入。
_sizeInvalid.en-US: Internal flag set by the component when the file size is out of range. Upload uses it to show the invalid size message; do not pass it manually.
